relations.rationale: Cleo and Yara being on different teams is consistent with and slightly supports the existence of multiple teams, aligning with there being three teams.
Vik's age relative to Dara has no bearing on which teams Dara and Yara are on.
Vik setting up watering cans is unrelated to the volunteers sharing coffee and pastries.
The break around ten provides a plausible occasion for sharing coffee and pastries, supporting that claim.
A break around ten is a distinct event from the midmorning bustle of activity, and taking a break doesn't necessarily support ongoing buzzing activity.
The short break around ten could be the same pause as the group admiring their progress, supporting that claim.
Dara and Yara being on different teams implies there are at least two teams, which is consistent with there being three teams.
The midmorning buzz of activity and progress described in 24 supports the later claim that the group paused to admire the progress made.
